native_text:
Every Thursday, the YYEA (Yung Yau English Ambassadors) sets up interactive game
booths to encourage students to speak and write in English. These engaging activities have
attracted hundreds of participants during festive occasions such as Halloween, Christmas,
Thanksgiving Day, Valentine’s Day, Women’s Day,
Easter, Earth Day, World Art Day, and Mother’s Day.
